Discover screen renders 12 seeded recipe cards, 6 garnishes, category chips (All/Cocktails/Mocktails/Wine-Beer) filter correctly, and search 'mojito' filters to Garden Mojito. Recipe detail page renders ingredients/steps segmented control and 'Add to Event' CTA; tapping the heart while unauth routes to /auth as expected. ui_bugs.issue: Close/X button dispatches router.back() but when /auth is deep-linked there is no back stack, producing console warning "The action 'GO_BACK' was not handled by any navigator." Consider router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/').

issues: React Native Web console deprecation warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Likely emitted by third-party components (linear-gradient / phosphor-react-native). Not blocking, but noisy in dev.

action_items: Optional: In /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx, guard the close button with router.canGoBack() to eliminate GO_BACK warning when /auth is deep-linked.
Optional: Investigate RN-Web deprecation warnings from phosphor-react-native / linear-gradient (props.pointerEvents, shadow* -> boxShadow).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: EventUpdate.dict() will drop keys explicitly set to None in a PATCH-style update (e.g. clearing notes). Consider body.dict(exclude_unset=True) so partial updates behave predictably.

server.py update_event returns get_event(event_id, user) — if the caller passes an unknown event_id, update silently updates nothing and returns 404 (acceptable) but no 404 is raised on the update itself. Fine as-is; noted for future.
server.py: /api/upload accepts .heic but content-type may be image/heic which some browsers won't render inline; consider server-side transcode if needed for gallery display.

server.py: get_favorites returns recipes filtered by {'id': {'$in': ids}} — good; note ordering is not stable (Mongo doesn't preserve $in order); consider sorting client-side by favorite created_at for consistent UX.
